product_metadata.title: Artesa Verona Rolling Laundry Garment Rack with Shelves, Black
features: VERSATILE: use as a garment rack or to organize laundry after washing; hang damp clothes from top bar to dry items that can't go in the dryer
SORT IT OUT: features two shelves for organizing folded clothes or storing laundry baskets plus top bar for hanging items
MOVABLE: the rack is set on four wheels, making it easy to transport to laundry room and around the home
DURABLE: sturdy carbon-structured steel frame withstands everyday use. Measures 28" length x 19" width x 71.25" high.
ATTRACTIVE: the clean lines and scrollwork in the shelves give this piece a modern design--you won't need to hide it away, when not in use
description: The Verona Laundry Rack with 2 Shelves from Artesa is a great tool for getting your laundry situation all sorted out. It features two shelves for organizing folded clothes or storing laundry baskets plus top bar for hanging items. Use it to organize clothes that need to be washed or put away, or hang damp clothes from top bar to dry items that can't go in the dryer. The rack is set on four wheels, making it easy to transport to laundry room and around the home. Made from durable, structured steel, the rack withstands everyday use, and its attractive, modern design makes it a piece you won't want to hide away. Measures 28 x 19 x 70.75 inches.
